display.purpose: Banner headlines only (Bold 700, the heaviest face shipped).

headline.purpose: Page titles (h1); product titles use a close step, clamp(1.1rem, 0.95rem + 0.7vw, 1.45rem) at 1.6; archive titles clamp(1.15rem, 1rem + 0.6vw, 1.45rem).

title.purpose: Shelf, offers, ranking and blog section titles, each led by the 14px saffron khatam star.

body.purpose: All running text; Persian digits via ss01.

body-small.purpose: Descriptions, meta, menu and footer text.

product-name.purpose: Product cell names, clamped to exactly two lines (3.5em).

price.purpose: Card prices, always ink, tabular figures; currency name Quiet Slate at 0.78em Regular.

price-lead.purpose: The buy-box price on the product page.

label.purpose: Category-circle names, sort links, breadcrumbs, promise lines, chips.

badge.purpose: The saffron discount tag, the sold-out badge and the saffron cart count.

latin-data.purpose: Email, URL, password, SKU, tracking codes and credentials: plain Vazirmatn, features off, LTR.

code.purpose: System monospace for <code>, <kbd> and <pre> only: 0.9em, features off, LTR and isolated; <pre> in a Porcelain well with 6px corners.

shadows.name: shadow-s
shadows.purpose: Resting panel: every white panel and frame on the ground, including the sign-in panel and the confirmation card.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Floating: drawers, sub-menus, shelf arrows, skip link, flying cart image.

shadows.name: cell-hairlines
shadows.purpose: Hairlines between product cells, drawn as shadows so the outer panel edge stays clean.

shadows.name: mega-drop
shadows.purpose: Full-width category panel under the header.

shadows.name: header-scrolled
shadows.purpose: Sticky header once the page scrolls.

shadows.name: tabbar-edge
shadows.purpose: Bottom tab bar over scrolling content (buy bar uses -10px 24px -18px at 45%).

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Soft Lapis ring around a focused field or quantity stepper, with a Focus Lapis border.

shadows.name: count-knockout
shadows.purpose: White ring separating the saffron cart-count pill from the bag icon.

shadows.name: waiting-halo
shadows.purpose: Saffron Cream halo around the 10px saffron 'account after payment' dot.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for drawers, drops, rises, dots, bumps and image zoom.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and shadow changes on buttons, fields, chips, links and tabs (the sign-in tab underline eases over 0.25s).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press; quantity steps press to 0.94.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Menu and filters drawers slide in from the reading edge over a 0.25s backdrop fade.

motion.name: mega-hover-intent
motion.purpose: Stops the menu flashing when the pointer only crosses the toggle; a click within 600ms of a hover-open keeps it open.

motion.name: banner-autoplay
motion.purpose: Slide interval; pauses on hover, focus and touch, stops with the pause button, never runs under reduced motion.

motion.name: fly-to-cart
motion.purpose: Signature: the card image arcs (up 60px) into the visible cart, shrinking to 12% and rounding to a circle.

motion.name: count-bump
motion.purpose: Saffron cart count after it changes.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Phone buy bar appearing above the tab bar.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Notices and the added-to-cart link appearing.

motion.name: confirmation-rise
motion.value: translateY(12px) to 0 over 0.5s; tracking check pops from scale 0.5 over 0.4s after 0.2s; account check after 0.35s
motion.purpose: Phone-account confirmation card and its status marks.

motion.name: ornament
motion.purpose: The khatam lattice, section star and header rule never animate.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition durations 0.01ms; scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion everything above is off; JS also skips flight, bump and autoplay and hides the pause button.

breakpoints.name: phone-shell (tab bar, drawer, two-row header, filters drawer)

gradients.name: banner-lapis
gradients.purpose: Default banner tone under --pattern-light; white type (5.21:1 at the highlight, 7.50:1 on Lapis).

gradients.name: banner-plum
gradients.purpose: Plum banner tone under --pattern-light; white type (6.58:1 at the highlight).

gradients.name: banner-saffron
gradients.purpose: Saffron banner tone under --pattern-dark; ink type (7.43:1 at the darkest stop), ink button with white type.

gradients.name: offers-band
gradients.purpose: Special-offers band under --pattern-light; white title and View all (7.50 to 10.01:1).

gradients.name: header-rule
gradients.purpose: 3px rule along the top of the header; Lapis on the right, above the wordmark in RTL.

patterns.name: pattern-light
patterns.purpose: Khatam lattice on lapis and plum: 64px tile, one eight-point star (20px outer radius) centred with quarter stars at the corners, 1px white strokes at 13%.

patterns.name: pattern-dark
patterns.purpose: The same lattice on saffron, 1px Indigo Ink strokes at 9%.

patterns.name: mark-star
patterns.purpose: Solid eight-point star used as a mask: the 14px saffron mark before every section title.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lapis solid button for primary actions (white on it 7.50:1); deepens to Deep Lapis on hover, presses to 98%.

components.name: Ghost Button

components.description: The search-first header field: borderless Porcelain well, icon at the start, white with a Focus Lapis border and soft Lapis ring on focus.

components.description: Form field: white, 46px, Control Rule stroke, Lapis caret, Focus Lapis border and soft Lapis ring on focus; Error Red asterisk, border and message; Latin-data fields switch to plain Vazirmatn, LTR.

components.description: White pill links with a Quiet Slate count, in one sideways-scrolling row under archive titles.

narrative.overview:
Sofreh is the Iranian online marketplace every shopper already knows, played straight: a search field up front, a swipeable banner, a row of round category shortcuts, a band of special offers, dense product cells with the discount beside the price, and a tab bar under the thumb. The benchmark for familiarity and finish is Digikala, but the store never borrows its name, logo, red or assets, and its own colours set it clearly apart. Convention is the commitment. Nothing here is a concept layout, so quality has to show in the things shoppers feel without naming: price rows that line up across a shelf, Persian digits everywhere, 44px targets, honest empty states, and speed.

The material is warm and plain, set with a few jewels. White panels sit on a warm porcelain ground. Lapis means acting: buttons, links and where you are. Saffron means saving: discount tags and the cart count. Plum is lapis's deep partner in the banner and the offers band. Text is an indigo-tinted ink with a quiet slate for everything secondary, divided by 1px warm hairlines and marked with round-capped line icons. Red has left the storefront and now marks errors only. One Persian ornament carries the identity: the khatam, the eight-point star of Iranian tilework. It appears as a fine line lattice over the banner and the offers band, and as a small solid saffron star before every section title. A 3px saffron, plum and lapis rule along the top of the header echoes it. Density is marketplace density, not editorial air: product cells sit edge to edge, divided by hairlines, and a single 12–20px gap separates the panels. The phone is the store (about 80% of visits): every layout is designed at 390px first, and desktop extends it with a search-led header, a category mega menu, shelf arrows, and a sticky buy box.

Motion is moderate and purposeful. There is one authored moment, add to cart: the product's own image arcs into the cart and the count bumps. Around it sit a few working motions: a banner that swipes and autoplays but yields to the shopper, a hover-intent category menu, and drawers that slide in from the reading edge. Everything else is short state feedback, and all of it switches off under reduced motion. The ornament never moves.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar marketplace structure, executed precisely; no invented layouts.
White panels on a warm porcelain ground, one container level deep.
Lapis for actions and current state, saffron for offers, plum for depth; red for errors only.
One ornament, the khatam: a fine line lattice on the banner and offers band, and a saffron star before every section title.
Vazirmatn throughout, Persian digits through `ss01`, line-height 1.8.
Phone-first shell: two-row header, bottom tab bar, phone buy bar.
One authored motion moment (add to cart), and nothing moves under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Lapis Means Acting Rule
rules.body: Lapis marks what you can press and where you are: buttons, links, the wordmark, current tabs, sort links and filters. Sale prices and headings stay ink. The only large lapis fields are the lapis banner tone and the offers band.

rules.name: The Saffron Means Saving Rule
rules.body: Saffron belongs to offers and small marks: discount tags, the cart count, the section star, rating stars and the saffron banner tone. It is always a fill or a mark, never text, and anything written on it is Indigo Ink.

rules.name: The Red Means Error Rule
rules.body: Error Red and its washes appear only where something is wrong, unavailable or being removed: required asterisks, invalid fields, error notices, out-of-stock, failed statuses and the remove hover. No action, offer, price or ornament is red.

rules.name: The Plum Stays Deep Rule
rules.body: Plum is a field colour for the banner, the offers band and the middle of the header rule. It never appears on buttons, text or interface chrome.

rules.name: The Persian Digits Rule
rules.body: Everything a shopper reads uses Vazirmatn FD with `ss01` switched on explicitly, so ASCII digits draw as Persian even when isolated (an old price, a badge). Stored data keeps ASCII digits. Fields and values that hold Latin data (email, URL, password, SKU, tracking code, generated credentials) switch to plain Vazirmatn with features off, set LTR and isolated. Phone and postcode fields stay in the Persian-digit face and convert typed Persian digits to ASCII.

rules.name: The No Tracking Rule
rules.body: Persian text never gets letter-spacing or a text transform. Emphasis comes from weight (500 or 700) or size.

rules.name: The One Container Level Rule
rules.body: A white panel sits on the porcelain ground, and that is the only level of container. Zones inside a panel are separated by hairlines or set in a Porcelain well. A white, shadowed card never sits inside another white panel.

rules.name: The Thumb Zone Rule
rules.body: Below 961px the bottom 64px (plus safe area) belongs to the tab bar. Fixed elements stack above it, never over it, and touch targets stay at 44px or more (drawer rows are 48px).

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Anything resting on the ground gets the resting shadow, and anything floating over content gets the floating pair. Full-width bars and the mega panel use its edge variants. Shadow never stands in for emphasis.

rules.name: The One Ornament Rule
rules.body: The khatam is the store's only motif. It appears in three places: the lattice on banner slides, the lattice on the offers band, and the saffron star before section titles. The header's jewel rule is its companion. No other pattern, flourish or illustration joins it, and it never animates.

dos: Do set every content block as its own white panel (16px corners, resting shadow) on the Porcelain (#f7f4ef) ground, separated by the 12–20px gap.
Do keep Lapis (#2d48c0) for actions, links, the wordmark and current-state indicators, and Deep Lapis (#1e339b) for their hover and focus.
Do keep Saffron (#faab35) for discount tags, the cart count, the section star and rating stars, always with Indigo Ink (#191d34) on it.
Do keep Error Red (#b32228) and its washes for errors only: required asterisks, invalid fields, out-of-stock, the remove hover, error notices and failed statuses.

Do lay the khatam lattice (64px tile, 1px strokes, white at 13% on lapis and plum, ink at 9% on saffron) over banner slides and the offers band, and lead every section title with the 14px saffron khatam star.
Do tint the resting, floating and edge shadows from Indigo Ink (`rgb(25 29 52 / x)`).
Do build the price row as the discount tag at the start, the current price at the end, and the old price on its own line beneath. Reserve that line when there is no old price.
Do show a variable product with differing option prices as «از» plus the lowest price.

Do print product prices through `sofreh_kses_price()`, so WooCommerce's `<bdi>` survives and the amount reads «۲٬۷۵۰٬۰۰۰ تومان», number then currency. Keep WooCommerce's currency position on Left or Left with space.
Do render every number a shopper reads in Vazirmatn FD with `ss01` on, and switch Latin-data fields (email, URL, password, SKU, codes) to plain Vazirmatn, LTR.
Do offer the account as «ورود» / «ساخت حساب» over WooCommerce's own forms, in the My Account tabs, the header guest link and the checkout note.
Do draw icons from the theme's inline line-icon set, or as CSS masks of the same round-capped paths.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more, and stack every fixed bottom element above the 64px tab bar on phones.
Do leave store promises and the product note empty until the merchant writes them; empty ones stay hidden.
Do switch all motion off under `prefers-reduced-motion`: no autoplay (pause button hidden), no image flight, no count bump, instant scrolling.
donts: Don't use Digikala's name, logo, red or proprietary assets. Match its conventions and quality bar only, and never drift back to a red-led storefront.
Don't escape price HTML with `wp_kses_post()`, which strips `<bdi>` and moves the currency name to the wrong side, and don't switch WooCommerce's currency position to Right.
Don't put a white, shadowed card inside a white panel. Inner zones use hairlines or a Porcelain well.
Don't put the discount tag over the product photo. It belongs in the price row (or beside the buy-box price), and only the sold-out badge sits on the image.
Don't colour an action, offer, price, heading or ornament red.
Don't set text in Saffron or put white on it (1.92:1). Saffron is a fill under ink or a mark.
Don't colour sale prices, headings or large areas Lapis. The lapis banner tone and the offers band are the only lapis fields.
Don't use Plum on buttons, text or interface chrome.
Don't add a second motif, enlarge the khatam into an illustration, or animate it.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji (★, ×, ✓, typed plus and minus) as icons.
Don't add letter-spacing or text transforms to Persian text.
Don't add motion beyond the set above. In particular, no scroll-triggered entrances on sections and no autoplay that ignores pointer, touch, focus or the pause button.
